build_evaluator: build an Evaluator instance with config and evaluation file to score programs
run_evaluate_program: run evaluate_program on a single program code string and return metric scores
run_evaluate_multiple: run evaluate_multiple to evaluate a list of programs in parallel with a task pool
run_cascade_evaluate: run cascade evaluation with stage1 stage2 and stage3 functions for progressively harder tests
run_llm_evaluate: run LLM evaluation on program code to get quality metrics from an LLM ensemble
